name: [🏠HOUSES]Momo City [Beta]
desc:
[BETA PHASE]🛠️

Momo City is an Japanese Life Sim and live-service game that takes inspirations from popular franchies like Animal Crossing and Sims series! 

Create your avatar in an never before seen avatar creator!🌸
Dress up with realistic clothes from magical chests, stores and more!👗
Move into an dream-like world of Fantastic Japan! You will meet many friendly and unfriendly faces in Momo City! 
We hope you have an safe flight to Momo City!✈️

llm.loop: create avatar -> dress up from chests and stores -> furnish house -> explore Japanese-style town and meet NPCs
llm.objectives: unclear; life sim: decorate home, collect clothes, live in Momo City
llm.progression: Moni currency, clothing collection, houses, badges (73)
llm.instructions: create your avatar, dress up with clothes from chests and stores, move into Momo City
unique: Animal Crossing / Sims inspired single-player life sim on Roblox
monetization_signals: Moni currency packs up to 10,000 Robux
llm.thumbnails: kawaii avatars outside a pink house, airport lobby, anime-style key art, realistic avatar faces
llm.complexity_notes: custom avatar creator, realistic clothing, town map with NPCs, housing system
